answer: A bond is refunded only after 15 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. The river counter is kept in nadir and lagoon reveals each reset. An farming party therefore has to keep every alias continuously active for 15 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. A farm of 696 identities would post 1454 proofs and burn roughly 82 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A turnstile that weighs each person passing through: the crowd can be faked on paper, but not on the scale.
